hero.kicker: Built specifically, and exclusively, for one man
hero.headline: Dave. You're invited. Obviously.
hero.blurb: Twenty-two years of friendship have led to this: a bespoke website, a bespoke menu, and a seat as far from the speakers as we could manage.

menu.intro: Dave, your menu has been curated by a panel of people who have watched you eat. Priya's is the normal one; hers is on the second tab of her own choosing, because we like her.

courses.title: Starter
courses.note: You have three options and we both know which one you'll pick.

options.label: Prawn cocktail, 1974 presentation
options.description: Served in a glass, with a slice of lemon on the rim, as God intended.

options.label: Garlic bread
options.description: You asked for this at a Michelin-starred restaurant in 2019. We have not forgotten.

options.label: Wild mushroom pithivier
options.description: Genuinely excellent, before you say anything.

options.label: Beef, well done, with ketchup
options.description: The chef has agreed to this only in writing and only for you.

options.label: A whole Viennetta, unsliced, handed to you
options.description: Binding. There is no sharing clause.

sections.title: Terms and conditions of your attendance
sections.intro: By RSVPing you agree to the following, which are legally binding in the barn.
items: The 2011 Prague story is retired. Permanently.
You are not doing a speech. There is no speech slot for you. Do not prepare a speech.
You may request one song. One. It has already been vetoed.
You are on Table 4 with people who find you funny. Enjoy it.

sections.body: I'll definitely be there, mate, just need to check a couple of things.
sections.attribution: Dave, in response to every invitation since 2008

faq.q: Is there parking for the van?
faq.a: Yes, but not next to the marquee. Not again.

privateNotes: Chase him. He will not reply until the week of the deadline. Priya is the reliable one — her number is in the shared contacts.

adminMeta.known dietary: None. Claims a shellfish thing that is not real.
